assets.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset: one opaque 16:9 landscape background for the 2D fighting game Infernal Versus. Recreate the supplied official Helluva Boss production background as the Sloth clinic consultation room, retaining the exact room identity, its lilac upper wall, deep purple lower wall, pale pink horizontal trim, tiled violet floor, left wall shelf, overhead pink cabinet silhouettes and pink lower cupboards on the right. Preserve the wall-mounted sink/tap, tissue dispenser and the whimsical purple radio with a tooth-shaped speaker on the counter. Preserve the angular purple and magenta lighting and the same front three-quarter camera. Remove ONLY the entire floor-standing purple container filled with syringes at the center-right, leaving clean continuation of the existing wall trim and tiles behind it: that container will be a separate scenery sprite. Keep a continuous clear foreground floor across the bottom quarter for side-view fighting, with no new platform, furniture, door, signage or architecture invented. No people, characters, blood, HUD, logos or watermark. Clean sophisticated hand-painted 2D television-animation background, crisp tapered outlines, controlled cel shadows, same color palette and characteristic shape design as reference. One finished background, no panels or collage. The scene is a static source-guided adaptation for gameplay.

assets.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset: one isolated static trophy sprite for the Helluva Boss game gallery, transparent background. Extract and faithfully redraw ONLY the trophy on the RIGHT of the supplied official production background. It has a cream clown head with a peach forehead V, small blue-purple pointed horns, sparse narrow blue eyes, wide peach smile, one shiny round pink nose, and large maroon three-lobed hair tufts on both sides. Below the head is a purple bow tie, tall tapered lavender trophy body with the exact hand-lettered words BOZO AWARD, a five-petal pink flower on the lower front and a small faceted lavender pedestal with a pink rectangular plaque. Preserve its complete visible silhouette, same three-quarter front camera, palette and blue room highlights from the source. No other trophy, bouquet, photo frame, counter or room. Entire single trophy in frame, at least 8 percent transparent margin on every side. Crisp clean hand-drawn 2D animation lines, restrained cel shading, no photoreal texture, no added decorations, no watermark. Real transparent alpha surrounding the trophy.
